fact: The strategy states there is no National Disaster Recovery Center for MAC ICT systems and no up-to-date national DR plan, that the NIR has no dedicated DR site, that only the Central Bank of Liberia runs a DR center (used mainly by financial institutions), and sets a target of an approved national DR plan by Q3 2026 and a DR data center by Q4 2027.
title: "Whole of Government" National Digital Strategy
publisher: Government of Liberia, Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications
